en: O noble support of the world, grant me this boon: let my inner self be intent upon the contemplation of its own true nature. 1.
O Hari, when will there be no dwelling within me with desire, anger, and the like? O Hari, may your beautiful form reside within me unbrokenly. 2.
May the mind be unattached to the body, the home, the door, and the possession of wife, children, and so forth; may it be attached only to your grace.
Let there be for me neither wealth, nor pride, nor fame; O, release my neck from this supreme bond which is the very form of delusion! 4.
May my stainless devotion always be directed toward Your lotus feet, which possess neither worldly enjoyment nor renunciation, neither learning nor artistic skill, yet remain free from agitation. 5.
May men and women, both externally and internally, become the very form of Hari; may my articulate speech utter the mantra: "Rāma, Kṛṣṇa, Hare. (6)
"‘I’ and ‘mine’ may be dissolved; let ‘you’ and ‘yours’ arise. O Lord of the World, let the reality of ‘I’, ‘you’, and ‘they’ become one. (7)
O Lord of the gods, show me this duality consisting of devotion to You while the indivisible non-duality remains; for this is my prayer directed toward You. 8.
